Description of Work: This Presolicitation notice announces an upcoming requirement for two cedar shingle roof replacements at the Gold Beach Ranger Station, located within the Gold Beach Ranger District in Curry County, Oregon. The existing cedar shingle roofs will be removed and replaced with new cedar shingles. The Gold Beach Ranger Station, located at 29279 Ellensburg Avenue in Gold Beach, Oregon, is situated along Highway 101 within one mile of the Pacific Ocean. The site and its buildings are considered to possess historical significance. The forthcoming solicitation will detail the selection process and outline all evaluation criteria that interested offerors will be required to address. One Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) contract is anticipated to be awarded. The estimated period of performance is 90 days from issuance of the Notice to Proceed, with work expected to begin in September 2026. Description of Work: This Presolicitation notice announces an upcoming requirement for two cedar shingle roof replacements at the Gold Beach Ranger Station, located within the Gold Beach Ranger District in Curry County, Oregon. The existing cedar shingle roofs will be removed and replaced with new cedar shingles. The Gold Beach Ranger Station, located at 29279 Ellensburg Avenue in Gold Beach, Oregon, is situated along Highway 101 within one mile of the Pacific Ocean. The site and its buildings are considered to possess historical significance. The forthcoming solicitation will detail the selection process and outline all evaluation criteria that interested offerors will be required to address. One Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) contract is anticipated to be awarded. The estimated period of performance is 90 days from issuance of the Notice to Proceed, with work expected to begin in September 2026.
